title: S-GAP: Stealthy Graph Attack Primitives for Graph Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.23465v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph Large Language Models (GraphLLMs) enable powerful semantic understanding and reasoning over Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs), while their semantic reasoning may exhibit vulnerabilities to perturbations in node text and graph structure under adversarial attack evaluation. Existing attacks typically construct textual and structural perturbations in separate stages guided by distinct realization intents. However, this separation results in attack-intent fragmentation, causing semantic incoherence between the two perturbation types, thereby undermining attack stealth and making them easier for GraphLLMs to identify and disregard, ultimately weakening attack effectiveness. To avoid attack-intent fragmentation, we propose the Graph Attack Primitive (GAP), an atomic semantic representation that unifies textual and structural perturbations under a coherent attack intent. translated_title: S-GAP：针对图大语言模型的隐蔽图攻击原语
translated_abstract: 图大语言模型（GraphLLM）能够对文本属性图（TAG）实现强大的语义理解与推理，然而在对抗攻击评估中，其语义推理可能对节点文本和图结构的扰动表现出脆弱性。现有攻击方法通常在由不同实现意图引导的独立阶段中分别构建文本扰动和结构扰动。然而，这种分离导致攻击意图碎片化，造成两类扰动之间的语义不连贯，从而削弱攻击的隐蔽性，使攻击更容易被GraphLLM识别和忽略，最终降低攻击有效性。为避免攻击意图碎片化，我们提出了图攻击原语（GAP），这是一种原子化的语义表示，能够在连贯的攻击意图下统一文本扰动和结构扰动。通过仔细校准GAP的语义构成，我们可以实现（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出图攻击原语（GAP）这一原子化语义表示，将文本扰动与结构扰动统一在连贯的攻击意图下，解决了现有针对图大语言模型的对抗攻击中攻击意图碎片化、隐蔽性差的问题。
